image_description: A close-up, high-resolution shot of an African crocodile's head and upper jaw. The mouth is slightly open, revealing conical teeth. The skin texture is highly detailed, showing rough, armored scutes on the dorsal side and smoother scales near the jawline. The eye is visible with a vertical slit pupil. The background is blurred, focusing entirely on the reptile's head.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout (narrower than alligator).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The snout tapers to a point, consistent with the V-shape of a crocodile rather than the U-shape of an alligator. The head structure appears broad and robust.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Jaws are massive with numerous conical, interlocking teeth visible when mouth is closed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mouth is open in the image, so the condition 'when mouth is closed' cannot be verified. However, the visible teeth are conical and sharp, consistent with the species.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are positioned dorsally on the head with vertical slit pupils and a nictitating membrane.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eye is clearly visible on the top/side of the head. The pupil is a distinct vertical slit. The nictitating membrane is not clearly deployed but the eye structure is anatomically correct.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Nostrils are positioned at the tip of the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The very tip of the snout is cut off by the left edge of the frame; nostrils are not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is elongated and heavily armored.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the neck and head shows heavy armor plating (scutes), consistent with an elongated, armored body.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is covered in thick, bony scutes (osteoderms) arranged in regular longitudinal rows along the dorsal surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The texture on the top of the head and neck shows distinct, raised, bony ridges and scutes arranged in a pattern consistent with crocodilian anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Scutes are dark brown to grey with a rough, heavily textured appearance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coloration is greyish-brown with significant textural variation, matching the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is covered in smooth, rectangular scales that are pale yellow to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The ventral surface (belly) is not visible in this head-shot angle.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet; forelimbs have five digits, hind limbs have four.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Limbs are completely out of frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and muscular, comprising half of total body length.

The geometry of the lower jaw near the left edge seems to merge indistinctly with the background or a foreground element. The edge definition drops off sharply, suggesting a slight generation error or masking issue at the boundary.
